evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 茹古涵今之南為長春仙館門三楹正殿五楹後殿為緑䕃軒正殿西廊後為麗景軒（圓明園冊）臣等謹按長春仙館為皇上舊時賜居四十景之一也其後恭值佳辰令節迎奉安輿駐居斯館殿額與緑䕃軒麗景軒諸額皆御書殿内聨曰安輿歡洽宜春永慶節誠依愛日長亦御書
evidence.summary: South of 茹古涵今: 長春仙館, a three-bay gate and five-bay main hall, 緑䕃軒 behind and 麗景軒 to the west. The note says this was Qianlong's own residence as a prince, later used to receive his mother on festival days.

evidence.title: 丽景轩: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 仲春喜得雨如膏，丽景天成不易遭。润透平畴盈一尺，波添曲沼涨三篙。桃蹊湿雾含朱靥，柳岸凝烟拓翠绦。慰矣钦哉增感惕，力田终岁念民劳。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 丽景轩, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 丽景轩: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 韶华富丽布亭台，廿四番风渐欲来。岭缀祥霙时玉荫，水含绮旭晓冰开。阳坡已觉柔莎织，暖坞无须羯鼓催。更喜郊原多润泽，绿盈宿麦畅栽培。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 丽景轩, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 丽景轩: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 由来多丽属青阳，啿啿群生万汇昌。卉木川原成锦绣，佳哉大块焕文章。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 丽景轩, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 丽景轩歌
evidence.locator: v2 p.94, under 长春仙馆; source ref 1-306
evidence.excerpt_zh: 韶华九十敷春籥，太和翔洽皇仁博。无边丽景展芳园，卉木滋荣正东作。青阳斡运启三农，又继昨年千万钟。锡福要荒庆绥屡，念征旸雨愿皆从。行庆元夕惠藩国，奕禩钦承为法则。伫看露布络绎来，大武绩赢咏七德。
evidence.summary: Poem 丽景轩歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 丽景轩
evidence.locator: from p.172, under 长春仙馆
evidence.summary: 丽景轩: 4 dated items, 1796-1802, of which 4 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1796, last dated 1802.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
